data.claim: A parentless commit-tree of the base tree minus excluded paths, bundled under a temp ref, ships no history; a returned branch landed through plumbing with the host's excluded paths restored needs no checkout.
data.falsifier: A clone of the bundle that lists more than one commit or any .ddflow/events path.
data.mechanism: commit-tree writes a commit with no parent, so the bundle holds only that commit's tree objects; git fetch from a local bundle or repo path brings the lane's tip, and read-tree plus index-info rebuilds a tree on the original base.
data.probe_output: test passed (21 passed in the file): clone has 1 commit, src/a.py present, no .ddflow/events path, host repo has no leftover temp ref
data.question: Can a git bundle carry the base tree to a remote lane without the event log or any committed secret in history, and come back without the host trusting the lane?
